purpose: Fresh response-blind real-system validation of calibration-only selective promotion without a post-response taxon-selection step.

source.title: Not all surveillance data are created equal – a multi-method dynamic occupancy approach to determine rabies elimination from wildlife

independent_target_definition.binary_response: 1 when prospectively identified rabies-positive count for the site-season is greater than zero; 0 when sampled raccoons are present but positive count is zero
independent_target_definition.basis: dataset description and associated study define the response as positive and negative raccoon rabies surveillance; no species-name choice will be made from response values

CovariateData.csv.role: response-blind site geometry and site covariates

SurveillanceData.csv.role: biological response plus survey effort; forbidden before final freeze

authorized: file names, sizes, checksums and content links only

scientific_boundary.success_question: Does the frozen calibration-only selector yield strictly lower untouched outer macro log loss than baseline in this genuinely new ecological surveillance system?

no_rescue: Do not open SurveillanceData.csv before geometry, response parsing, partition, model, Layer-B and selector contracts are frozen.
Do not redefine the target after response access.
Do not change source version or substitute files after a live failure in this attempt.
Do not treat metadata/schema/estimability STOP as predictive evidence.
